einzeiler: Kenny faces additional charges and community fallout in Steamboat Springs.
kurzfassung: After Kenny's release from jail, his lawyer warns him to expect additional charges. As Kenny and Cindy work on their defense, they realize severe damage has already been done. Word spreads throughout Steamboat Springs regarding allegations of sexual abuse against Cindy's son.
stichpunkte: Kenny is released from jail and warned by his lawyer about expected additional charges
Kenny and Cindy work together to defend themselves against the legal situation
The community of Steamboat Springs learns about the allegations involving Cindy's son
beschreibung:
After Kenny’s release from jail, his lawyer warned him that something was brewing and to expect additional charges. As he and Cindy worked to defend themselves, they learned the damage was already done. Word has spread throughout Steamboat Springs that Kenny didn’t just abuse Cindy’s son – he sexually abused him.
